rationale: Builds directly on the current best quantization path while finally testing the two highest-priority untried local-MLX hyperparameter directions from PR #1612. The script already matches MATRIX_LR=0.02 and MUON_MOMENTUM=0.95; this run lifts QK_GAIN_INIT to 4.0 and raises MUON_MOMENTUM_WARMUP_START to 0.90 so attention sharpens earlier without changing artifact size, eval logic, or hot-path structure. Added logging records the transplanted settings for attribution.
title: PR1612 QK Gain And Muon Warmup Transplant
